items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The envelope copy on page 2 shows a formal service (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) with the handwritten delivery date 23.11.2026 (Monday). Formal service has no 'deemed delivery' fiction — the stated delivery date is the actual start day. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself (23.11.) is not counted; the two-week period starts 24.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of weeks ends on the day of the last week bearing the same name as the starting event day, i.e. Monday 07.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in Niedersachsen (no shift needed), so the Einspruch must reach the Bußgeldstelle by 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the Gesamtbetrag (fine, fee and delivery costs)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the Bußgeldbescheid becomes final (Rechtskraft), which is a condition that only arises if no Einspruch is filed. If no Einspruch is lodged by the deadline of 07.12.2026, the decision becomes final on the following day, 08.12.2026. Counting from there under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (day of the event not counted) and § 188 Abs. 2 BGB (period ends on the day bearing the same name two weeks later): 08.12.2026 + 2 weeks = Tuesday 22.12.2026, a normal working day, so no further shift applies. This date only holds if the person does not file an Einspruch; filing one suspends the Rechtskraft and this payment deadline does not apply as calculated.

warnings: The payment deadline of 22.12.2026 is only correct if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026 (it assumes Rechtskraft enters on 08.12.2026); filing an Einspruch stops this clock entirely.

Several names in the letter look like generic placeholders (Landkreis Musterammerland, Fenja Musterwolde, 'Landesmusterbank') rather than a real authority and bank — worth double-checking that this is a genuine notice from your actual local Bußgeldstelle before paying or relying on the dates, even though the IBAN itself is a structurally valid German IBAN.

Before transferring the Gesamtbetrag, confirm the account holder name shown by your bank's mandatory payee-match check (Empfängerüberprüfung) matches the Landkreis/Bußgeldstelle, and do not pay to an account named differently without checking through contact details you already trust.
